name: OCTOPUS M1 — B2B Infiltrator: Discovery → Signed Candidate Submission (v1.1)

parameters.content:
## SETUP (read first) — v1.1 SECURITY MODEL
This workflow COLLECTS and PROPOSES only. It ends at a signed POST to the
Octopus ingestion boundary. It holds NO gate credentials, NO Telegram
credentials, NO SMS/email credentials. Approval cards, owner verdicts,
LANGAR, EffectorGate and all outbound sends are owned by Octopus.

1) Credentials to create in n8n:
   - HTTP Header Auth `domainApi` → header `X-Api-Key: <DOMAIN_API_KEY>`
   - HTTP Header Auth `anthropicApi` → header `x-api-key: <ANTHROPIC_KEY>`
2) Fill CONFIG: suburbs, business identity, OCTOPUS_BASE_URL, HMAC secret.
3) n8n env var required for the signing node:
   NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto
4) typeVersions written for n8n 1.x — accept version-bump prompts on import.
5) Removed in v1.1 (reviewer correction): Telegram card node, /gate/* calls,
   WF2 callback workflow. See n8n_wf2_REMOVED_README.md.
